Kirk Materne has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Oracle’s expanding AI infrastructure strategy and financial positioning. He interprets the latest 10-Q as confirming that Oracle is aggressively scaling its cloud and AI data center footprint, with customers effectively sharing in the funding through sizable prepayments, which supports the company’s growth runway despite near-term margin pressure.

data.title: Cogent Biosciences Earns Buy Rating as Bezuclasnib Advances Toward 2027 PDUFA and Multiple 2026 Catalysts; $55 Price Target Reaffirmed
data.description:
Analyst Sam Slutsky from LifeSci Capital maintained a Buy rating on Cogent Biosciences and keeping the price target at $55.00.

Sam Slutsky has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, chiefly the FDA’s acceptance of Cogent’s NDA for bezuclasnib in advanced systemic mastocytosis, with a clear regulatory timeline culminating in a June 29, 2027 PDUFA date. The robust APEX trial results, showing strong overall and pathological response rates with a tolerability profile that appears favorable versus Ayvakit at the AdvSM dose, reinforce confidence in clinical differentiation and commercial potential.

Slutsky also points to a series of additional PDUFA dates by year-end 2026 in 2L GIST and NonAdvSM, creating multiple near- to mid-term catalysts that can unlock incremental value. Cogent’s early commercial buildout, including field-based teams and an expanded access program in the U.S., supports a smoother launch trajectory, while the unchanged $55 price target reflects his view that the shares remain attractive given the pipeline breadth and upcoming INDs for CGT1815 and CGT1145.

data.title: BlossomHill: Buy Rating Reiterated as BH-30643 Data Strengthen Case for C797S-Focused Path; $32 Price Target Maintained
data.description:
In a report released today, Charles Zhu from LifeSci Capital maintained a Buy rating on BlossomHill Therapeutics, Inc., with a price target of $32.00.

Charles Zhu has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, most notably the emerging clinical profile of BH-30643 from the SOLARA Phase 1/2 study in C797S-mutant patients. The updated WCLC 2026 data show a maintained overall response rate in the mid-40% range, alongside encouraging treatment durability with most patients remaining on therapy at roughly seven months of median follow-up, which supports confidence in the drug’s efficacy trajectory.

Safety findings, including liver-related laboratory abnormalities, appear consistent with expectations and manageable, with no Hy’s Law cases observed, reinforcing the therapeutic window for BH-30643. Together with a clear path toward a C797S-focused accelerated approval discussion in late 2026 and a discounted cash flow valuation that supports an unchanged $32 price target, Zhu views BlossomHill’s risk-reward profile favorably and sees meaningful upside potential in the shares.
